FNUS53 KABR 232323
FWFABR

Fire Weather Forecast For Central/NE South Dakota WC MN
National Weather Service Aberdeen SD
623 PM CDT Fri Oct 23 2026

.DISCUSSION...

Strong southerly winds gusting up to 30 to 40 miles per hour are in 
place this afternoon, with the strongest gusts located over parts of 
northeastern South Dakota. Gusts over that area are expected to 
persist through the evening and into tonight. Localized strong gusts 
upwards of 40 miles per hour may be possible due to downsloping 
impacts on the eastern side of the Sisseton Hills. Due to the 
combination of these winds and the abnormal heat, widespread High 
Grassland Fire Danger is in effect today, with some areas of Very 
High Grassland Fire Danger where winds are the strongest. 

Overnight tonight, a cold front will move across the forecast area. 
Behind the front, winds will turn northwesterly and increase over 
central and north central South Dakota. Gusts as high as 50 miles 
per hour will be possible behind the front, and a Wind Advisory is 
in place for that area from late tonight through Saturday morning. 
Since the strongest wind gusts are anticipated to occur during the 
early morning and decrease through the day, they will not occur at 
the same time as the lowest afternoon humidity. This limits much of 
the forecast area to Moderate Grassland Fire Danger, although some 
stray areas of High Grassland Fire Danger over central and north 
central South Dakota will be possible. Humidity while the Wind 
Advisory is in effect will bottom out at 40-50 percent.
